briefs.headline: Padres blank the Reds 5-0 and pull even for a wild card
briefs.summary: Michael King struck out six over six innings and Manny Machado had four hits Monday; San Diego scored four in the fourth off Brady Singer, and Cincinnati fell to 65-73.

briefs.headline: Browns claim cornerback Toriano Pride off waivers from Buffalo
briefs.summary: Cleveland released veteran edge rusher Julian Okwara to make room Monday; Pride was the Bills' seventh-round pick, 220th overall, in the 2026 draft.

briefs.headline: Bengals claim tackle Myles Hinton from the Eagles
briefs.summary: The 6-foot-6, 342-pound 2025 sixth-rounder from Michigan joins the swing-tackle competition with Javon Foster; Cincinnati had released Cody Ford last week.

sections.label: Around the Leagues

briefs.headline: Messi retires from international soccer after 207 caps
briefs.summary: The 39-year-old announced Monday he is done with Argentina duty, 125 goals and a 2022 World Cup later; he wrote the letter July 21, two days after the World Cup final loss to Spain, and held it through his father's illness and Aug. 8 death. He plays on for Inter Miami.

briefs.headline: Cubs bury the Brewers 17-3 behind eight home runs
briefs.summary: Alex Bregman hit three solo shots and drove in four at Wrigley Monday, and Clay Holmes took the win; Milwaukee's NL Central lead over second-place Chicago is down to seven games.

briefs.headline: Aki basho opens in 12 days, and the JSA still posts no schedule
briefs.summary: The association's English pages carry Monday's banzuke (rankings) and sold-out notices for every Tokyo session, but no dates; the Sept. 13 opening derives from the second-Sunday rule and remains formally unconfirmed.

prime.item: OPEN as of 12:01 this morning, through Sept. 14, in joint and coastal waters: one fish per day, 15-inch minimum, mandatory harvest reporting. The season notice is the authority - the standing bag-limit table still shows last year's closure.

waters.working: Down from 176 a day ago and settling into true low-summer form - thin, clear and spooky. Fine tippet and one small dry, ants and beetles under the shaded banks through midday, and the deeper bends once the sun is fully on the water.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 24.9 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Steady at pool - shad are the forage, so run a swimbait off the wing-dam tips at first light, then slow to a jig dragged along the same seams as the sun climbs.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.5 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Holding steady below the dam - work a crawfish crankbait tight to the riprap and lock wall, and pitch a jig into the barge cuts where fish sit off the current.

waters.reading: Sound high 12:07 PM at 4.0 ft at Hampstead, lows 5:57 AM at 0.4 ft and 6:42 PM at 0.9 ft; the cycle's first high fell at 11:30 PM (Mon) at 3.6 ft.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of the 12:07 PM high in the sound.
waters.working: Flounder season opened at 12:01 this morning, and flounder want moving water against structure - pilings, channel edges, creek mouths - so the flood into the 12:07 high and the first of the fall behind it are the windows. Waning gibbous at 80%, the springs easing toward neap. The monthly Topsail report (Fisherman's Post, published Aug. 3 and a month old) has whiting and black drum in the surf on shrimp, per East Coast Sports. Water 84.6F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and the read that matters; the oceanfront pier runs well ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. No watches, warnings or advisories posted for the Topsail area this morning per the National Weather Service.

kicker: Flounder is open on the coast through Sept. 14, and Messi's Argentina career ended with a letter written in July.
